tagline: Text to broadcast: one narrated, subtitled film through 23 named passes
role: Wirecut (repo veo2) turns an article, report or PDF into a stitched film by multi-pass concretization: source → spine → telling → script → board → prompts → footage → mix → verdict, each pass a named, priced, receipted LLM call with the operator sovereign at every gate. Its storytelling doctrine (twelve laws, 12 narrative approaches, 13 telling dials, retention doctrine) and its quality gates (dailies, screening, retrospective) are the estate's storytelling and film-editing methods.
